name: Ituporanga (Brazil)
description: Quartered white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms: a shield divided blue with a yellow figure and white with green hills, over a scroll reading 1912 ITUPORANGA 1948.
history: Ituporanga is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a blue and white shield with a yellow figure and green hills, reading 1912 ITUPORANGA 1948
